# kubesense_dashboard_json (Resource)

A KubeSense dashboard managed as its preset JSON. Use kubesense_dashboard to write panels as blocks instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A preset kept next to the configuration, e.g. from the dashboard's
# "Export to Terraform" action in the UI.
resource "kubesense_dashboard_json" "checkout" {
  name           = "Checkout service"
  description    = "Golden signals for checkout"
  dashboard_json = file("${path.module}/dashboards/checkout.json")
}

# A file from the dashboard's "Export" action wraps the preset in an envelope
# with the preset as a string; unwrap it like this.
resource "kubesense_dashboard_json" "from_export" {
  name           = "Payments"
  dashboard_json = jsondecode(file("${path.module}/payments.export.json")).preset
}

# One dashboard per JSON file in a folder.
resource "kubesense_dashboard_json" "service" {
  for_each       = fileset("${path.module}/dashboards", "*.json")
  name           = title(replace(trimsuffix(each.value, ".json"), "-", " "))
  dashboard_json = file("${path.module}/dashboards/${each.value}")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard_json` (String) The dashboard preset as JSON: panels, layout, variables and tabs. Use the file from the dashboard's Export to Terraform action, or jsondecode(file("export.json")).preset for a file from Export. Checked against the server's dashboard schema at plan time.
- `name` (String) Dashboard name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Dashboard description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the dashboard was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Dashboard id.
- `updated_at` (String) When the dashboard was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Bring an existing dashboard under Terraform by its id.
terraform import kubesense_dashboard_json.checkout 2b0e8f3a-6a51-4f3e-9b8e-0c7d1f2a9e41
```
